Game Overview

Tap Tap Challenge puts players into a ball experience centered on race against real players in Tap Tap Challenge, a competitive and ever-changing tapathon. Guide your ball through generated paths, collecting gems, and navigate tricky obstacles with precise taps. Enjoy the thrill of seeing your name in the top spot as you unlock new ball skins.
